text:
maria.p: Heads-up: rolling HorizonRT (rt-nano, rt-medium, rt-xlarge) and Smart Failover for hosted API to GA today. This includes new realtime streaming path and routing policy headers. :tada:

sam: Sweet. Where can I find the quickstart?

maria.p: DevEx has a shortstart guide and code samples. DevEx link: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/horizonrt-quickstart

rachel: What does Smart Failover change by default? Any opt-out?

maria.p: Default is enabled for new orgs. Behavior: if primary route has degraded health or elevated tail latency, we switch to a compatible fallback (same family or quantized variant in another region). You can opt out per-route in Console or set header x-rw-routing-policy: "no-fallback".

devex: Sample curl for streaming (unofficial example):

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY"
  -H "x-rw-routing-policy: prefer-low-latency"
  -d '{"model":"rt-medium","input":"stream me"}'
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/stream
```

And Node example in the guide.

ops-bot: rollout 1856.12 started by maria.p — canary 5% traffic in us-east-1. Monitor: https://deploy.redwood.ai/1856.12

sam: Any breaking api changes for customers using the old realtime endpoints?

maria.p: No breaking changes — old endpoints remain. New endpoints are additive: /v1/realtime/stream and /v1/generate-rt. Small deprecation: legacy query param fallback=false will be removed in 90 days; migrate to header.

eng-oncall: Oncall will observe canary dashboard. Alert thresholds: p95 increase >15% or error rate >2x baseline triggers rollback.

rachel: Pricing impact?

maria.p: No price change today. HorizonRT is more throughput-efficient for streaming, so customers may see better cost/throughput. We will communicate any future pricing separately.

product: We'll draft the external release note and update the API changelog. Expect customer-facing docs by EOD.

sam: I'll flip our demo to rt-nano and run a smoke test after canary.

maria.p: Awesome — please add any canary issues to the rollout board and tag eng-oncall. Thanks everyone :rocket:
